title: Network-only tools: chapter leaders who run one chapter, up to ten central admins who reach every chapter, and an approval queue before a chapter event goes network-wide

source.ref: Owner spec 2026-10-16 (Daniel): Network gets "a chapter tree, chapter leaders who only see their own chapter, 10 central admins, one membership that works in every chapter, an approval queue for network-wide events, one network calendar and home, and a roll-up report." Build order item: "Network-only tools: chapter leaders, the approval queue and central admins."

detail: A Chapters area (/spaces/[slug]/settings/chapters) on a Network parent, reached from the network home's Manage chapters button, run by the owner and the central admins and a 404 for everyone else, chapter leaders included. Chapter leader: an active admin space_members row on one chapter, assigned from the parent's roster with the chapter's seat check, so a leader holds nothing on another chapter or the parent; Remove steps them down to member. Central admins: the owner names up to NETWORK_PLAN.centralAdmins (10) people from the parent roster; add_network_central_admin enforces the cap under a parent row lock and the person becomes an admin of the parent. getSpaceCapabilities then grants admin (never isOwner, so billing stays the owner's) on every current chapter while they are named and still an active admin of the parent. Approval queue: on a Network the network calendar and home show the parent's own events plus approved chapter events only; the Chapters area lists upcoming undecided chapter events with Approve and Decline, and the action re-reads the chapter calendar before writing. Everything is gated on planRank network; a Collective's calendar, member Spaces and report are unchanged. Migration 20270346009300 adds network_central_admins and network_event_approvals (service role only, listed in rls-deny-all) and a trigger that clears both when a parent's owner changes and clears a chapter's decisions when it leaves or joins a parent. Not in this row: a menu row for Chapters (the catalog gates by function key, not plan, so the door is the network home), invalidating an approval when the event is edited, and approving events shared into a chapter from outside the Network's own calendars.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const m=r('supabase/migrations/20270346009300_network_tools.sql');if(!/create table if not exists public.network_central_admins/.test(m)||!/create table if not exists public.network_event_approvals/.test(m))bad.push('migration tables missing');if(!/v_used >= 10 then raise exception 'network_central_admins_full'/.test(m))bad.push('central admin cap not enforced in the database');const t=r('lib/collective/network-tools.ts');if(!/planRank\\(space.plan\\) >= PLAN_CAPABILITY_RANK.network/.test(t))bad.push('tools not gated on the Network plan');if(!/named && isNetworkChapter\\(chapter, parent\\)/.test(t))bad.push('central admin reach not limited to chapters');if(!/networkCentralAdminReach\\(space.id, profileId\\)\\) memberRole = 'admin'/.test(r('lib/spaces/entitlements.ts')))bad.push('central admins do not reach chapter admin');if(!/networkEventShown\\(\\{ network, fromParent/.test(r('lib/collective/network-store.ts')))bad.push('network calendar does not wait for approval');const p=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/chapters/page.tsx');if(!/networkToolsAccess\\(space.id, callerId\\)/.test(p)||!/if \\(!access\\) notFound\\(\\)/.test(p))bad.push('Chapters area not gated');const a=r('lib/collective/network-tools-actions.ts');for(const f of ['approveNetworkEvent','setChapterLeader','setCentralAdmin'])if(!a.includes('export async function '+f))bad.push(f+' missing');if(!/if \\(!access\\?\\.isOwner\\) return fail/.test(a))bad.push('central admins not owner only');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-983: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
